literal_meaning: গলায় পা রাখা বা চাপ দেওয়া (to place or press foot on the throat)
similar_in_english: Put one's foot on someone's neck
example_sentences_in_bangla: অন্যায়কারীরা দুর্বলদের উপর গলায় পা দিয়ে শোষণ করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The rulers have put their foot on the people's necks.
The wrongdoers are oppressing the weak by putting their foot on their throats.
note: This idiom vividly depicts subjugation, often used in contexts of power imbalance in Bengali discourse.
